4. **Layer 3 MLP:** turns yq (0–54) into a single digit for output. At the `=` position it scores the tens digit, and at the next position it scores the ones digit. The output layer just reads those 10 digit scores.

The answer is generated one token at a time inside the network; Python never computes it.
